description_en: Queries the Object Storage Service (OSS) storage plans that you have purchased in a region. Storage plans can be used to offset the storage capacity of standard snapshots but do not support offsetting local snapshots
description_zh: 调用DescribeSnapshotPackage查询您在一个阿里云地域下已经购买的OSS存储包。存储包可以用于抵扣标准快照存储容量，但不支持抵扣本地快照
name: DescribeSnapshotPackage

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the OSS storage plan list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
OSS存储包列表的页码。起始值：1

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：100

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the snapshot. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 快照所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the OSS storage plan list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数

SnapshotPackage.description_en: The collection of storage plan information
SnapshotPackage.description_zh: 存储包信息组成的集合

DisplayName.description_en: The name of the storage plan

EndTime.description_en: The expiration time of the storage plan. The time follows the [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html） standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 存储包的过期时间。按照[ISO8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

InitCapacity.description_en: The maximum capacity of the storage plan

StartTime.description_en: The purchase time of the storage plan. The time follows the [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html） standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 存储包的购买时间。按照[ISO8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of OSS storage plans returned
